# Gradient map

Replaces every pixel with a color from a three-stop gradient chosen by its brightness, for thermal-camera, neon or tinted-print looks.

<EffectDemo effect="gradient-map" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { gradientMap } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/gradient-map';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(gradientMap({ preset: 'thermal' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.shadows = '#120458'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type      | Default     | Range       | Description                                    |
| ------------ | --------- | ----------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `shadows`    | hex color | `'#120458'` |             | Color for the darkest areas.                   |
| `midtones`   | hex color | `'#ff2a6d'` |             | Color at the midpoint.                         |
| `highlights` | hex color | `'#fff6c2'` |             | Color for the brightest areas.                 |
| `midpoint`   | number    | `0.5`       | 0.05 – 0.95 | Brightness that maps to the midtone color.     |
| `amount`     | number    | `1`         | 0 – 1       | Mix between the original and the mapped image. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                                               |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `thermal`   | `shadows: '#1a0b3d'`, `midtones: '#e3403a'`, `highlights: '#ffe66b'`, `midpoint: 0.45` |
| `cyberpunk` | `shadows: '#120458'`, `midtones: '#ff2a6d'`, `highlights: '#05d9e8'`                   |
| `print`     | `shadows: '#2e1d12'`, `midtones: '#a07856'`, `highlights: '#f3e3c3'`, `amount: 0.85`   |
| `ice`       | `shadows: '#03142e'`, `midtones: '#3a7bd5'`, `highlights: '#e6f7ff'`                   |

Apply one with `gradientMap({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.7 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/gradient-map`, including the shared effect runtime.
